name: Hydration, Thirst, Water Consumption & Health Effects Runtime
design_rules: hydration declines continuously according to activity and climate
thirst is a readable physiological signal rather than the hydration value itself
safe water restores hydration without adding waterborne exposure
unsafe water may restore hydration while simultaneously increasing health risk
dehydration progressively affects stamina and recovery before becoming critical
water need increases with heat and exertion
health consequences accumulate from exposure rather than firing from a single arbitrary dirty-water flag
hydration state persists across world time
hydration never uses emissive or glow feedback
